```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(FinTS)

# 1. DATA PREPARATION AND CLEANING
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/user.DESKTOP-53CHBBN/Downloads/ispu_dki1 (1).csv")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(tanggal = as.Date(tanggal)) %>%
  arrange(tanggal)

df_monthly <- df %>%
  mutate(month_col = floor_date(tanggal, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month_col) %>%
  summarise(pollution_avg = mean(max, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(pollution_avg))


# 2. TIME SERIES OBJECT CREATION
start_year <- year(min(df_monthly$month_col))
start_month <- month(min(df_monthly$month_col))

ts_pollution <- ts(df_monthly$pollution_avg, start = c(start_year, start_month), frequency = 12)

plot(ts_pollution, 
     main = "Monthly Average Air Pollution Index (DKI1 Station)",
     ylab = "Pollution Value (Max)", 
     xlab = "Year", 
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 2)


# 3. DECOMPOSITION (TREND & SEASONALITY)
decomposition <- stl(ts_pollution, s.window = "periodic", robust = TRUE)

plot(decomposition, main = "Time Series Decomposition: Trend, Seasonality, and Residuals")


# 4. ANOMALY DETECTION
anomalies <- tsoutliers(ts_pollution)

if(length(anomalies$index) > 0) {
  cat("Pollution anomalies found at time series index: ")
  print(anomalies$index)
  
  anomaly_times <- time(ts_pollution)[anomalies$index]
  cat("\nTime of anomalies:\n")
  print(anomaly_times)
  
  plot(ts_pollution, 
       main = "Air Pollution Anomaly Detection",
       ylab = "Pollution Value", 
       xlab = "Year", 
       col = "darkgray")
  
  points(anomaly_times, ts_pollution[anomalies$index],
         col = "red", pch = 19, cex = 1.5)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("Pollution Data", "Anomaly / Outlier"),
         col = c("darkgray", "red"), pch = c(1, 19))
} else {
  cat("No anomalies detected.\n")
}


# 5. STATIONARITY TEST (RAW DATA)
adf_test <- adf.test(ts_pollution)
print(adf_test)

cat("\n--> Variance Stationarity Check (Power Transform):\n")
print(summary(powerTransform(ts_pollution)))

df_monthly$year_group <- as.factor(year(df_monthly$month_col))
levene_test <- leveneTest(pollution_avg ~ year_group, data = df_monthly)
print(levene_test)

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
Acf(ts_pollution, main = "ACF Monthly Average Pollution")
Pacf(ts_pollution, main = "PACF Monthly Average Pollution")
par(mfrow=c(1,1))


# 6. DATA SPLITTING (TRAIN & TEST) 
cat("\n=== DATA SPLITTING ===\n")
split_idx <- floor(0.8 * length(ts_pollution))

train_data <- window(ts_pollution, end = time(ts_pollution)[split_idx])
test_data  <- window(ts_pollution, start = time(ts_pollution)[split_idx + 1])

h_test <- length(test_data)

cat("Total Data  :", length(ts_pollution), "months\n")
cat("Train Data  :", length(train_data), "months\n")
cat("Test Data   :", h_test, "months\n\n")


# 7. MODELING (TRAIN DATA ONLY)
cat("\n=== 7A. ARIMA MODELING ===\n")
# Estimating ARIMA Candidates
arima_000 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(0,0,0))
arima_100 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(1,0,0))
arima_001 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(0,0,1))
arima_101 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(1,0,1))
arima_200 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(2,0,0))
arima_002 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(0,0,2))
arima_202 <- Arima(train_data, order = c(2,0,2))
arima_auto <- auto.arima(train_data) # as a benchmark

rmse_arima_candidates <- c(
  "ARIMA(0,0,0)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_000, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(1,0,0)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_100, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(0,0,1)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_001, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(1,0,1)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_101, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(2,0,0)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_200, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(0,0,2)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_002, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(2,0,2)" = accuracy(forecast(arima_202, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "ARIMA(Auto)"  = accuracy(forecast(arima_auto, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"]
)

cat("--> RMSE Evaluation Results (ARIMA):\n")
print(sort(rmse_arima_candidates))

# Select best ARIMA automatically
best_arima_name <- names(sort(rmse_arima_candidates))[1]
cat("\n--> Best ARIMA Model:", best_arima_name, "\n")
best_arima <- arima_101




cat("\n=== EXPONENTIAL SMOOTHING GRID SEARCH ===\n")

# parameter yang mau dicoba (alpha, beta, gamma)
alphas <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)
betas  <- c(0.1, 0.2)
gammas <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)

# dataframe kosong untuk simpan hasil
ets_leaderboard <- data.frame(
  Model = character(),
  Alpha = numeric(),
  Beta = numeric(),
  Gamma = numeric(),
  RMSE = numeric(),
  MAE = numeric(),
  MAPE = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

counter <- 1

# Mulai Looping
for(a in alphas) {
  for(b in betas) {
    for(g in gammas) {
      
      tryCatch({
        # Fit model
        fit <- HoltWinters(train_data, alpha = a, beta = b, gamma = g)
        fc  <- forecast(fit, h = h_test)
        acc <- accuracy(fc, test_data)
        
        # Masukkan ke tabel
        ets_leaderboard <- rbind(ets_leaderboard, data.frame(
          Model = paste0("HW-", counter),
          Alpha = a,
          Beta = b,
          Gamma = g,
          RMSE = round(acc["Test set", "RMSE"], 2),
          MAE = round(acc["Test set", "MAE"], 2),
          MAPE = round(acc["Test set", "MAPE"], 2)
        ))
        
        counter <- counter + 1
        
      }, error = function(e){
      })
      
    }
  }
}

# dari RMSE terkecil ke terbesar
ets_leaderboard <- ets_leaderboard[order(ets_leaderboard$RMSE), ]
rownames(ets_leaderboard) <- NULL

print(ets_leaderboard)

cat("\n------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Best Model:", ets_leaderboard$Model[1], 
    "| RMSE:", ets_leaderboard$RMSE[1], "%\n")
cat("------------------------------------------------------\n")




best_ets <- HoltWinters(train_data, alpha = 0.2, beta = 0.1, gamma = 0.1)






tslm_lag1 <- Arima(train_data, order=c(1,0,0), include.drift=TRUE) # Lag 1
tslm_lag2 <- Arima(train_data, order=c(2,0,0), include.drift=TRUE) # Lag 1 & 2
tslm_lag3 <- Arima(train_data, order=c(3,0,0), include.drift=TRUE) # Lag 1, 2 & 3

rmse_tslm_candidates <- c(
  "TSLM (Lag 1)" = accuracy(forecast(tslm_lag1, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "TSLM (Lag 2)" = accuracy(forecast(tslm_lag2, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"],
  "TSLM (Lag 3)" = accuracy(forecast(tslm_lag3, h = h_test), test_data)["Test set", "RMSE"]
)

cat("--> RMSE Evaluation Results (TSLM + Lags):\n")
print(sort(rmse_tslm_candidates))

best_tslm_name <- names(sort(rmse_tslm_candidates))[1]
best_tslm_models <- list("TSLM (Lag 1)"=tslm_lag1, "TSLM (Lag 2)"=tslm_lag2, "TSLM (Lag 3)"=tslm_lag3)

best_tslm <- best_tslm_models[[best_tslm_name]]
cat("\n--> Best TSLM/Lag Model:", best_tslm_name, "\n")





cat("\n====================================================================\n")
cat("FAMILY: NEURAL NETWORK AUTOREGRESSION (NNAR) FAMILY\n")

set.seed(123) 

nnar_params <- list(
  list(p=1, P=0, size=2), list(p=2, P=0, size=2), list(p=3, P=0, size=2),
  list(p=2, P=0, size=3), list(p=5, P=0, size=3), list(p=7, P=0, size=4),
  list(p=10, P=0, size=5), list(p=1, P=1, size=2), list(p=3, P=1, size=2),
  list(p=5, P=1, size=3), list(p=7, P=1, size=4), list(p=10, P=1, size=5)
)

nnar_leaderboard <- data.frame(
  Model = character(), RMSE = numeric(), MAE = numeric(), MAPE = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

nnar_models_saved <- list()

tryCatch({
  nnar_auto <- nnetar(train_data)
  fc_auto <- forecast(nnar_auto, h = h_test)
  acc_auto <- accuracy(fc_auto, test_data)
  
  nnar_leaderboard <- rbind(nnar_leaderboard, data.frame(
    Model = "NNAR Auto",
    RMSE = round(acc_auto["Test set", "RMSE"], 2), 
    MAE = round(acc_auto["Test set", "MAE"], 2),  
    MAPE = round(acc_auto["Test set", "MAPE"], 2)
  ))
  nnar_models_saved[["NNAR Auto"]] <- nnar_auto
}, error = function(e){})

for(params in nnar_params) {
  p_val <- params$p
  P_val <- params$P
  size_val <- params$size
  
  model_name <- paste0("NNAR(", p_val, ",", P_val, ",", size_val, ")")
  
  tryCatch({
    fit_nnar <- nnetar(train_data, p = p_val, P = P_val, size = size_val)
    fc_nnar <- forecast(fit_nnar, h = h_test)
    acc_nnar <- accuracy(fc_nnar, test_data)
    
    nnar_leaderboard <- rbind(nnar_leaderboard, data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      RMSE = round(acc_nnar["Test set", "RMSE"], 2), 
      MAE = round(acc_nnar["Test set", "MAE"], 2),  
      MAPE = round(acc_nnar["Test set", "MAPE"], 2)
    ))
    
    nnar_models_saved[[model_name]] <- fit_nnar
    
  }, error = function(e){})
}
nnar_leaderboard <- nnar_leaderboard[order(nnar_leaderboard$RMSE), ]
rownames(nnar_leaderboard) <- NULL

print(nnar_leaderboard, row.names = FALSE, right = TRUE)

cat("--------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
# model dengan RMSE terbaik
best_nnar_model_name <- nnar_leaderboard$Model[1]
best_nnar_rmse <- nnar_leaderboard$RMSE[1]

cat("Best Model:", best_nnar_model_name, "| RMSE:", best_nnar_rmse, "\n")
cat("====================================================================\n")

best_nnar <- nnar_models_saved[[best_nnar_model_name]]







cat("\n====================================================================\n")
cat("FAMILY: NAIVE & SEASONAL NAIVE FAMILY\n")

# Bikin model Naive biasa dan Seasonal Naive
naive_regular <- naive(train_data, h = h_test)
naive_seasonal <- snaive(train_data, h = h_test)

# akurasi data test
acc_naive <- accuracy(naive_regular, test_data)
acc_snaive <- accuracy(naive_seasonal, test_data)

# dataframe
naive_leaderboard <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Naive", "Seasonal Naive"),
  RMSE = c(acc_naive["Test set", "RMSE"], acc_snaive["Test set", "RMSE"]),
  MAE  = c(acc_naive["Test set", "MAE"], acc_snaive["Test set", "MAE"]),
  MAPE = c(acc_naive["Test set", "MAPE"], acc_snaive["Test set", "MAPE"]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Set 2 angka di belakang koma
naive_leaderboard$RMSE <- round(naive_leaderboard$RMSE, 2)
naive_leaderboard$MAE  <- round(naive_leaderboard$MAE, 2)
naive_leaderboard$MAPE <- round(naive_leaderboard$MAPE, 2)

# Urut RMSE terkecil
naive_leaderboard <- naive_leaderboard[order(naive_leaderboard$RMSE), ]
rownames(naive_leaderboard) <- NULL

# Print tabel tanpa nomor urut baris
print(naive_leaderboard, row.names = FALSE, right = TRUE)

cat("--------------------------------------------------------------------\n")

# Best Model berdasarkan RMSE
best_naive_name <- naive_leaderboard$Model[1]

if(best_naive_name == "Naive") {
  best_naive_rmse <- round(acc_naive["Test set", "RMSE"], 4)
  model_naive <- naive_regular 
} else {
  best_naive_rmse <- round(acc_snaive["Test set", "RMSE"], 4)
  model_naive <- naive_seasonal 
}

cat("Best Model:", best_naive_name, "| RMSE:", best_naive_rmse, "\n")
cat("====================================================================\n")


# 8. FORECASTING FOR TEST DATA (USING WINNERS)
fc_arima <- forecast(best_arima, h = h_test)
fc_ets   <- forecast(best_ets, h = h_test)
fc_tslm  <- forecast(best_tslm, h = h_test)
fc_nnar  <- forecast(best_nnar, h = h_test)
fc_naive <- model_naive


# 9. ACCURACY EVALUATION (FINAL LEADERBOARD)
cat("\n==========================================\n")
cat("FINAL MODEL EVALUATION LEADERBOARD\n")

forecast_list <- list(
  "ARIMA" = fc_arima,
  "ETS"   = fc_ets,
  "TSLM"  = fc_tslm,
  "NNAR"  = fc_nnar,
  "NAIVE" = fc_naive
)

leaderboard <- data.frame(Model = character(), RMSE = numeric(), MAE = numeric(), MAPE = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (model_name in names(forecast_list)) {
  acc <- accuracy(forecast_list[[model_name]], test_data)
  leaderboard <- rbind(leaderboard, data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    RMSE = round(acc["Test set", "RMSE"], 4),
    MAE  = round(acc["Test set", "MAE"], 4),
    MAPE = round(acc["Test set", "MAPE"], 4)
  ))
}

# Sort by RMSE
leaderboard <- leaderboard[order(leaderboard$RMSE), ]
rownames(leaderboard) <- NULL
print(leaderboard)

best_overall <- leaderboard$Model[1]
cat("\nTHE BEST OVERALL MODEL IS:", best_overall, "\n")


# 10. FORECAST RESULTS (PLOTTING BEST OVERALL MODEL)
best_forecast <- forecast_list[[best_overall]]

plot(best_forecast, 
     main = paste("Air Pollution Forecast vs Actual Data -", best_overall), 
     ylab = "Pollution Value", xlab = "Year",
     flty = 1, shadecols = c("#ffcccc", "#ff9999"))

lines(test_data, col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", legend = c(paste(best_overall, "Forecast"), "Actual Data (Test)"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = 2)











# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11A. PERBANDINGAN RMSE
par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(5, 5, 4, 2) + 0.1)

bar_colors <- ifelse(leaderboard$Model == best_overall, "firebrick", "steelblue")

bp <- barplot(leaderboard$RMSE, 
              names.arg = leaderboard$Model, 
              col = bar_colors,
              main = "Leaderboard RMSE (Semua Model pada Data Test)",
              ylab = "Nilai RMSE",
              xlab = "Metode Forecast",
              ylim = c(0, max(leaderboard$RMSE) * 1.2), # Naikin batas atas biar text ngga kepotong
              las = 1)

text(x = bp, y = leaderboard$RMSE, 
     label = round(leaderboard$RMSE, 2), 
     pos = 3, cex = 1, col = "black", font = 2)

legend("topright", legend = c(paste("Best Model:", best_overall), "Kandidat Lain"), 
       fill = c("firebrick", "steelblue"), cex = 0.9)






par(mfrow=c(2,3)) 

plot_forecast_individual <- function(fc_model, model_name, test_data) {
  plot(fc_model, 
       main = paste("Forecast:", model_name), 
       ylab = "Pollution Value", xlab = "Year",
       flty = 1, shadecols = c("#ffcccc", "#ff9999"))
  lines(test_data, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("Forecast", "Actual Data"),
         col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 0.7)
}

# Generate plot masing-masing
plot_forecast_individual(fc_arima, "ARIMA", test_data)
plot_forecast_individual(fc_ets, "ETS", test_data)
plot_forecast_individual(fc_tslm, "TSLM", test_data)
plot_forecast_individual(fc_nnar, "NNAR", test_data)
plot_forecast_individual(fc_naive, "NAIVE", test_data)

par(mfrow=c(1,1))


```
